data.title: Measure with Erasers!
data.description: Learn how to measure the length of everyday objects by tiling erasers end-to-end and counting them.

challenges.instruction: How many erasers long is the crayon?
challenges.hint: Try placing the erasers in a straight line along the crayon without leaving any gaps.
challenges.narration: Let us measure this crayon using erasers. Drag and drop the erasers end-to-end along the crayon, then count how many you used!

challenges.instruction: Can you measure the length of the ribbon using erasers?
challenges.hint: Make sure your erasers touch each other with no overlaps as you line them up.
challenges.narration: Great job! Now let us measure the ribbon. Place your erasers carefully from one end to the other.

challenges.instruction: How many erasers long is the straw?
challenges.hint: Count each eraser one by one as you place them along the straw.
challenges.narration: You are becoming a measurement star! Let us find out how many erasers long the straw is.
